dedupe_keys.name: iti ics security tools industrial protocol packet captures tools and guides for control system security

description: ICS-Security-Tools is a community collection of material for cyber security work on industrial control systems, and its most reusable part is a large library of network packet captures of industrial protocols. It is hosted by the Information Trust Institute at the University of Illinois with contributions from the ICS security community. Coverage: generic lab and field captures, not tied to one country. The pcaps folder holds several hundred captures for DNP3 (the largest set), Siemens S7, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, C37.118 synchrophasor, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC, MELSEC, Beckhoff and others, and further folders list analysis, audit, honeypot, simulation and testbed tools, protocol notes, hardware information, vendor lists, threat feeds and guides, with mirrored copies of many third-party tools. Format and access: PCAP files, scripts and Markdown in a public GitHub repository; free. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for the collection, with mirrored tools under their own licences. Caveats: captures come from many unrelated sources with little metadata on how or where they were recorded, and some are synthetic; the tool lists are not systematically maintained. Simulation uses: realistic protocol traffic for testing detection in cyber-physical cascading failure and resilience testbeds of power and water control systems. Related records: the IEC 61850 GOOSE security dataset (data-iec61850-goose-security-dataset-adsc) and the IEC 104 intrusion detection dataset (data-iec104-scada-ids-dataset) are labelled captures for single protocols.
